currentFocus: S345 closed a five-session carry at the root: resync-derived.mjs, the tool that repairs derived artifacts after a rebase, reported clean over a subset it could not see. Its evidence graph models 29 of 67 byte-checked generators, so it printed "17 artifacts rebuilt + staged" while CI failed ten minutes later on two artifacts outside the graph -- twice, in S340 and S341, both hand-fixed, both still unmodeled. Rather than guess the missing nodes sources (which the ratchet correctly forbids), every success exit now runs the unmodeled generators own --check: a measurement rather than a prediction. Also made check-scheduled-workflow-staleness declare which verdicts it actually exercised, so a fixture-only silent: 0 can no longer read as a verified all-clear. Next: the founder runs the one-command newsletter deploy, and picks the Desk cadence lever.
publicNote: A tool we use to repair the site after two changes collide had been quietly reporting success over only the part of the site it knew about, which is why a check failed twice after everything local looked fine. It now checks the parts it cannot map as well, and refuses to say "clean" when it has not looked. Separately, one of our alarms reported all-clear for a condition it had never actually seen happen; it now says so, so a quiet alarm cannot be mistaken for a tested one. Nothing visitors see changed this session.

lastSessionSummary: S345 -- resync-derived, the post-rebase repair tool, reported clean over a subset it could not see: its graph models 29 of 67 byte-checked generators, so it printed completeness while CI failed ten minutes later on build-intelligence-budget (S340) and build-nervous-system (S341). Modeling the other 38 was correctly refused -- guessing sources yields a confidently wrong graph -- so the fix runs the unmodeled generators own --check instead, a measurement needing none of the information the ratchet withholds. Default fails named (verified by reproducing the exact S340 incident: old path exit 0, new path exit 1), repair is opt-in and guarded, and a structural self-test stops any future exit path bypassing it. Also gave the cron staleness checker liveCorroboration so a fixture-only silent verdict declares itself. Newsletter deploy denied by the sandbox classifier a second time; Desk blocker sentence corrected rather than carried.
